CONTRAINDICATIONS INTRATHECAL ADMINISTRATION OF CORTICOSTEROIDS WITH IOPAMIDOL IS CONTRAINDICATED. BECAUSE OF OVERDOSAGE CONSIDERATIONS, IMMEDIATE REPEAT MYELOGRAPHY IN THE EVENT OF TECHNICAL FAILURE IS CONTRAINDICATED (SEE INTERVAL RECOMMENDATION UNDER DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION ). MYELOGRAPHY SHOULD NOT BE PERFORMED IN THE PRESENCE OF SIGNIFICANT LOCAL OR SYSTEMIC INFECTION WHERE BACTEREMIA IS LIKELY.
